open_points.subject: flow:create_and_correct_project — agent add-room approval
open_points.text: Without a standing approval, each room the agent adds waits for the owner's approval of the exact request, its name included
open_points.question: Before capability:projects.add_room is called for Kernel, which capability checks for a standing approval or acquires the owner's approval, and what exact request fields are bound to that approval?
options: Add a named Cabinet Kernel approval-gate step before the Registry call, binding the session, project, room name and request id
Treat approval as a precondition outside this flow and state explicitly that the flow begins only after Kernel has satisfied it
open_points.default_guess: Add a named pre-call Kernel approval-gate step binding the complete add-room request; call Registry only after exact or standing approval.

witness.initial: A registered agent session is granted an active, unarchived project; the agent proposes a valid room name and request id; the flow version has no standing approval.
events: The agent reaches an add-room node through Cabinet Kernel.
No owner approval of this exact request has yet been given.
Cabinet Kernel either waits as R0-96 requires or directly performs the Registry call described by State 4 step 5.
outcomes: The request waits and no room is written until the owner approves it.
Registry accepts the direct call and writes the room because every stated stage passes.
witness.observer: The owner sees either an approval request or a newly created room; the agent's run also observes whether the node waits or completes.

open_points.subject: flow:create_and_correct_project — refused add-room approval
open_points.text: the owner refuses a name that breaks the rule before it is written
open_points.question: When the owner refuses the exact add-room request, what result does Cabinet Kernel produce for the node and run: final refusal, cancellation, or a resumable request for corrected input?
options: Finish the node with a distinct owner-denied result and make no Registry call
Cancel the node and run and make no Registry call
Keep the node resumable so the agent can propose a corrected name, still making no Registry call until a new approval
open_points.default_guess: Finish the node with an owner-denied result, make no Registry call, and require a new node attempt with a new exact request.

witness.initial: A registered agent session is granted an active, unarchived project; there is no standing approval; the proposed room name breaks R0-96's writer rule.
events: The agent reaches the add-room node through Cabinet Kernel.
Kernel presents the exact request to the owner.
The owner refuses the name before Registry is called.
outcomes: The node and run finish with an owner-denied failure.
The node remains resumable and asks the agent for a corrected request.
witness.observer: The owner and the agent see different run status and different available next actions, although neither outcome writes a room.
